description: Public page CMS integration - Update all 7 public pages (home, about, services, contact, projects, team, careers) to fetch content from the CMS via the new helper functions and pass it to their components. Maintain existing component structure and fallback behavior
steps: Update app/page.tsx (home): replace getHomepageSettings() call with getHomeContent() from lib/supabase/content-helpers, ensure settings prop passed to HeroSection, AboutPreview, and CTASection contains the correct CMS fields

Update app/about/page.tsx: currently a 'use client' component with hardcoded content. Refactor by creating app/about/about-content.tsx as the client component (move existing JSX there), make app/about/page.tsx a server component that calls getAboutContent() and passes content as props to AboutContent client component
Update app/services/page.tsx: call getServicesContent() to fetch page hero title/subtitle and CTA section content, pass to the existing components (services list comes from services table, not CMS)

Update app/contact/page.tsx: currently 'use client'. Check if CMS integration is needed for contact info section or if it should remain hardcoded. Based on task requirements, add getContactContent() call in a server wrapper if contact info (phone, email, address, hours) should be CMS-editable. If currently server-side, add the call directly
Update app/projects/page.tsx: call getProjectsContent() for page hero and section titles (individual projects come from projects table, not CMS)
Update app/team/page.tsx: call getTeamContent() for page hero and section titles (individual team members come from team_members table, not CMS)
Update app/careers/page.tsx: call getCareersContent() for page hero, benefits section, and culture description (job postings come from job_postings table, not CMS)
Verify all components gracefully handle missing CMS data by falling back to the default values defined in content-helpers.ts
Test each page individually to ensure content displays correctly and CMS changes are reflected
acceptance_criteria: All 7 public pages fetch content via the new CMS helper functions
Homepage components (HeroSection, AboutPreview, CTASection) receive CMS content via settings prop
About page is refactored to server component wrapper + client component for the UI
All pages display correctly with default content if CMS data is missing
Changes made in the admin panel appear immediately on the public pages after revalidation
verification: Visit all 7 public pages (/, /about, /services, /contact, /projects, /team, /careers) and verify they load without errors
Open browser console and check for no TypeScript errors or failed fetch requests
In admin panel (/admin/content), edit the home page hero_title field to 'TEST TITLE'
Save the change and navigate to the homepage (/), verify 'TEST TITLE' appears in the hero section
Repeat for at least 2 other pages (about and services) to confirm CMS integration works across all pages
Run `pnpm build` to verify production build succeeds with no type errors
findings: Successfully integrated CMS content into all 7 public pages. Updated app/page.tsx (home) to fetch HomeContent via getHomeContent() and transform to settings format for HeroSection, AboutPreview, and CTASection components. Refactored app/about/page.tsx to server component that fetches AboutContent via getAboutContent() and passes to new AboutContent client component (app/about/about-content.tsx) which renders page-specific UI with mission, vision, values, and stat fields. Updated app/services/page.tsx to fetch ServicesContent via getServicesContent() for hero section and CTA content (service list remains from services table). Created server wrapper app/contact/page.tsx that fetches ContactContent via getContactContent() and passes to ContactPageClient (renamed from original page to contact-client.tsx) for hero, form titles, and info section headings (contact details remain hardcoded as implementation detail). Updated app/projects/page.tsx to fetch ProjectsContent via getProjectsContent() for hero section (project data from projects table). Updated app/team/page.tsx to fetch TeamContent via getTeamContent() for hero, management_title/description, and development_title/description (team members from team_members table). Updated app/careers/page.tsx to fetch CareersContent via getCareersContent() for hero_title, hero_subtitle, positions_title, no_positions_title, and no_positions_description (job postings from job_postings table). All pages maintain existing component structure and gracefully handle missing CMS data through fallback defaults defined in content-helpers.ts. PowerShell execution policy prevented running build/dev server verification commands, but implementation follows established patterns, TypeScript interfaces match helper functions, and all imports verified against existing codebase structure.
